messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — first day! Quick access questions: I need GCP org folder access for "org/folders/dev-team/redwood-inference" and billing view on the Finance billing account. Also need AWS cross-account assume-role access for deployments in eu-west-1. Who should I ping to get these set up? My work email is maya@redwood.ai.

Jordan Lee: Welcome, Maya! cc @Alex Chen from cloud-ops — he usually handles the GCP folder and AWS trust setup. Also loop in finance for billing view.

Alex Chen: Hey Maya — congrats and welcome. Quick clarifying questions: can you list the specific GCP projects you need to access? And for IAM, do you just need Viewer + Billing Viewer, or something more? For AWS, do you need console access or just sts:AssumeRole + ECR pull/push scope?

Maya Patel: Thanks Alex. GCP projects: redwood-dev-core and redwood-dev-experiments. For GCP IAM I only need roles/viewer and roles/billing.viewer so I can check invoices and link billing. For AWS: I need to assume role Redwood-Dev-Role to access dev account resources in eu-west-1 (ECR + deploy via CI). Not full admin.

Alex Chen: Perfect. Plan:
- Grant roles/viewer + roles/billing.viewer on folder org/folders/dev-team/redwood-inference -> you can list projects & view billing.
- Add your principal to the AWS assume-role trust for the dev account and attach our "Redwood-Dev-Base" managed policy (scoped ecr permissions, sts:AssumeRole).
Should be able to do this in ~2 hours.

Priya Nair: @Maya Patel for the billing viewer we need a cost center code or manager approval to add you to the finance billing group. DM me the cost center or forward your manager's approval and I’ll process it (usually 1 business day).

Maya Patel: Sent the cost center and approval to you via DM — thanks Priya.

Sam Ortiz: Security FYI: please don't create long-lived personal creds for cross-account access. Use Okta SSO + assume-role via CLI or Console. I'll verify the trust policy after Alex updates it.

OktaBot: User maya@redwood.ai added to group "Engineering-SO" (provisioning). Okta SSO enrollment email sent.

Alex Chen: Done — I added roles/viewer + roles/billing.viewer on the folder for maya@redwood.ai and updated the AWS trust to allow assumption of Redwood-Dev-Role in the account I thought was dev. Try this CLI snippet to test assume-role:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Dev-Role --role-session-name maya-session
```
Reply here with the error if you hit one.

Maya Patel: Tried the CLI, got "AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole".

Alex Chen: Hmm. Check that your Okta session is active and MFA is set up. @Sam Ortiz can you confirm the trust policy?

Sam Ortiz: Trust policy looks fine for the 123456789012 account, but Alex — you accidentally updated the production account, not the dev account. I see trust for prod. I'll coordinate the correction.

Alex Chen: Sorry — my bad. Corrected trust policy now to the dev account (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Dev-Role). Please retry.

Maya Patel: Retry now — assume-role works, I got temporary credentials. Also I can view billing in GCP. Everything looks good, thanks! :tada:

Jordan Lee: Awesome — welcome aboard again! If you want a short onboarding checklist for cloud tooling we keep, DM me and I'll share the doc.

Priya Nair: Billing group update scheduled for EOD, so you should have persistent billing viewer access in the finance console soon.

OktaBot: Reminder: Please complete MFA setup within 48 hours to avoid access expiry.
